toegepas.rede_vinder: The plural of 'nes' is 'neste', so the compound is 'perdebyneste'; this is a block heading, so the reviewer should send it to the writer if the script cannot apply it there.
toegepas.fout: The heading misspells the plural: 'nes' makes 'neste', so the compound is 'perdebyneste', not 'perdebynesse'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: A plain spelling fix in a heading that changes nothing about the meaning.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Doringtakke' is the natural Afrikaans compound for thorny branches.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Takke met dorings' is plain, natural Grade 4 Afrikaans and may be the video's own wording; 'doringtakke' is only a lateral swap.

laat_vaar.voor: Perde en beeste staan binne in hul eie hokkies.
laat_vaar.na: Daarbinne staan perde en beeste in hul eie hokkies.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'binne in' reads as 'inside their stalls'; 'daarbinne' makes clear the animals stand inside the stable, each in its own stall.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The original is already clear right after 'n gebou met mure en 'n dak'; the reorder is lateral and moves the 'inside' from the stalls to the stable.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Aanmekaar' (joined together) is written as one word, as the lesson itself does in 'aanmekaar sit'.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Aan mekaar vasgemaak' (fastened to each other, with 'aan' belonging to 'vasmaak') is correctly written as two words, so this is not a spelling error.

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Dun buitekant om die ruimte binne wat sonder 'n raam sy vorm hou.
na_skrywer.na: 'n Dun buitekant wat om 'n ruimte sit en sonder 'n raam sy vorm hou.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: In the original, 'wat sonder 'n raam sy vorm hou' seems to belong to 'die ruimte binne' rather than the outside, and 'die ruimte binne' sounds stiff.
na_skrywer.fout: In this glossary entry, which is read on its own, the clause 'wat sonder 'n raam sy vorm hou' can attach to 'die ruimte binne' instead of to 'buitekant', and 'die ruimte binne' reads stiffly; the study text uses the same phrase.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The fault is real, but it is a [begrip] definition that goes beyond a spelling fix, so the writer must reword it, in step with the study text's sentence.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

vlae.blok: Nie elke skuiling pas in een groep nie
vlae.teks: 'n Kraal van klip is nie 'n raam of 'n dop nie, maar 'n dik muur.
vlae.rede: Read literally, this says the kraal itself is a thick wall, though a kraal is an open enclosure with a wall around it (as the lesson says elsewhere). Saying it has or is made of a thick wall would change the claim slightly, so I flag it rather than change it.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: More natural word order: the object comes before the place adverb.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'maak dikwels daar hul huis' is already natural Afrikaans order; the proposal is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Both forms are correct, but the decided habitat definition in the glossary says 'lewe', so the body sentence should use the same verb.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'leef' and 'lewe' are equally natural and the body sentence paraphrases rather than quotes the definition, so this is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Baie voëlneste is soos 'n diep koppie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Baie voëlneste lyk soos 'n diep koppie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'lyk soos' is the natural way to compare a shape; 'is soos' sounds wooden.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'is soos 'n diep koppie wat die eiers binnehou' compares both shape and function, and 'lyk soos' narrows it to appearance only.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die plek waar 'n dier veilig is
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: A shelter is one of many places, as the study text itself says ('n Skuiling is 'n plek ...), so the indefinite article fits better than 'Die'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Die plek waar ...' is the normal definite form for a glossary definition and matches the decided habitat definition, so there is no fault and nothing to send to the writer.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: en hou 'n perdeby se nes stewig
laat_vaar_vorige.na: en maak 'n perdeby se nes stewig
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Hou ... stewig' is awkward for a material that hardens; 'maak ... stewig' is the natural collocation and keeps the meaning.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'hou 'n perdeby se nes stewig' (keeps it sturdy) is natural Afrikaans, and 'maak ... stewig' is a lateral move that shifts keeping into making.
